author: Patrikano
body:
Hola!

Well, I feel quite childish and to me this seems stupid that I actually have to report someone for something as childish and moronic as this, but it has come to the point where it is starting to piss me off.

http://imgur.com/a/SF18s

http://imgur.com/a/Knyxa

Now on her end, this is pretty pathetic. I don't even know why she hates me this much to be quite frank. 
I know this is barely worthy of a warn, but what i'm asking is if you could find a way to make her take a hint and to stop constantly harassing me in such a childish manner.

I don't know what you, as the staff could do about this, but even though she isn't saying bad words, it obviously is meant to offend me.

-Thanks in advance, Patrikano
